svg.title: Transposing gives the corresponding left lift. A two-sided lift requires a correction because an arbitrary left lift need not remain a right cycle. Suppose A is a two-form row with Ad1 = 0 and dT 1 A = 0 on all periods. Choose W by a left lift so dT 2 W = A. Put F = Wd1; then dT 2 F = 0. Lift again on the left to obtain a degree-four row T with dT 3 T = F. Now Td0 = 0: its left derivative vanishes since dT 3 Td0 = Wd1d0 = 0, and a left cycle in top degree four vanishes by the same lifting theorem, whose next form space in dimension four is zero. Right-lift T to obtain X with Xd1 = T. Define K = W −dT 3 X. Then Kd1 = 0 and dT 2 K = A, using d3d2 = 0. Right-lift K to obtain B with Bd2 = K. Thus dT 2 Bd2 = A. Every step is a finite composition of the preceding analytic lifts, exterior derivatives, sums and transposes, so the same familywise exponential decay statement holds. This proves the exterior factorization used for the fund; the refined block-length power in the sale estimate is additional quantitative information.
